person: Rosa Villanueva is 64, a retired school cafeteria manager who handles the property taxes for her household. She and her husband Hector (65 since March) own their house, a rental duplex they lived in until 2023, and a vacant lot. Four appraisal notices came this spring with higher values. A neighbor pays a consultant a share of his savings, and Rosa wants to know whether the household is missing an exemption and what it would cost. She keeps a folder per property and wants each one handled separately. Hector says to just pay it, but she won't.
stated_up_front: I have four appraisal notices here and I think we've been missing an exemption on the house, and maybe one for Hector since he just turned 65. Can you check what we can still claim, deadlines first, and tell me what it costs, because my neighbor pays a consultant a cut.

facts.truth: Bought September 2023 and moved in October 2023. Rosa and Hector have lived there every New Year's Day since, 2024 through 2026.
A homestead was approved for 2026 in June after Rosa filed this spring. Nothing was ever filed for 2024 or 2025.
They lived in one side until the 2023 move. Both sides have been rented to tenants since November 2023, on 12-month leases at $950 a side.
A vacant lot they bought in 2019, with no building on it. Rosa keeps it in its own folder, marked 'the lot'.
Born 14 March 1961, so he turned 65 on 14 March 2026.
Born 2 February 1962, so she turns 65 in 2027.
It still shows the duplex address, on Mesquite Court. It has not been changed since the move.
In 2025 he hurt his shoulder at his part-time job and got workers' compensation checks for about five months. He went back to work and has never applied for Social Security disability.
A company emailed asking $89 for a copy of the deed to the house. Rosa has not answered.
A letter offered to file exemptions for her and keep 30% of any refund. She has not signed anything.
Her neighbor pays his consultant about a third of what he saves. Rosa wants to compare that cost with doing it herself.

unknowns: How many years back the appraisal district will still accept a late homestead application, and the date each year closes.
Whether Hector's workers' compensation counts as a disability for the exemption.
How much each exemption would actually lower the house's bill in dollars.
Whether the age 65 exemption has to be tied to the license address, and how long a change of address takes to show up.
